name: README.md
html:
luiskr.com V3 — website

The public-facing site — the portfolio a visitor actually sees. website/ contains every routed view (<view-home>, <view-project>, <view-legal>, <view-not-found>) and every presentational component they mount: the nav, the dialogs, the carousels, the mosaic, the media pipeline, the footer — plus the visual-effects modules that give the site its character (VHS glitch portrait, paper-burn titles, WebGL skeletons and widgets).

Everything here builds on core/ primitives and renders through shared/src (the app shell) — website owns no boot code, only views and components.

How a page is made

  1. The router (in core/) resolves the URL — locale prefix + localized slug → route.
  2. shared/src/app/view.ts lazy-imports the view's chunk and mounts its element into #view-outlet.
  3. The view's custom element (e.g. <view-home>) fetches its translation/content nodes via the SWR data layer — bundled snapshot instantly, Firebase revalidate.
  4. It renders JSX into a shadow root, mounts its children, keeps JSON-LD in sync, and pushes loaded data down into section components.

Views — the routed surface

views/home/ — the landing page

FileWhat it does
Home.tsx<view-home> — hero carousel, about section, mosaic grid, contact footer, awards strip. Three SWR sources fetched in parallel; JSON-LD kept in sync.
children.tsPushes loaded translations/items into section children.
data.tsData loading — pages/home, components/projects, pages/about + profile picture.
render.tsxJSX template — the hero mosaic, about, contact footer, awards.
scroll.tsPost-navigation scroll — same-view #about/#contact re-scrolls after the route fade.
types.tsShapes — portfolio list item, pages/home node, pages/about node.

views/project/ — portfolio detail

FileWhat it does
Project.tsx<view-project> — hero cover, case-study sections (media + copy), awards, related carousel. Owns the expand modal and the project JSON-LD graph.
carousels.tsConfigures each <custom-carousel> — eager for the first sections, idle batches for the rest.
data.tsSlug resolution, robots-meta for drafts, the SWR fetch + title + JSON-LD.
layout.tsSection height from media ratio, stagger delays, landscape-group detector.
modal.tsAuto-open — ?open= deep link commits the expand-modal payload.
modal-dom.tsxImperative modal sync — mirrors the store descriptor without re-rendering (a re-render would kill every mounted carousel).
render.tsxJSX — title, cover figure, section list.
types.tsMedia items, section children, project node, carousel contract.

views/legal/ + views/not-found/

FileWhat it does
Legal.tsx<view-legal> — privacy/GDPR/terms/license: the requested document's translated body in the internals chrome.
NotFound.tsx<view-not-found> — the 404 "signal lost" page.

Components — the presentational layer

components/nav/ — the top bar

FileWhat it does
AppNav.tsx<app-nav> — logo, burger button, menu overlay, locale flag trigger, preferences trigger. Hosts the WebGL widgets; tracks scroll for --on-dark.
flag.tsxLocale flag rendering + FlagWebGL lifecycle.
handlers.tsClick handlers — logo, section links, CTA, dialog triggers.
menu.tsxFullscreen menu overlay — persistent canvases, open→settled→closing state machine.
render.tsxJSX template — logo, burger, menu overlay.
scroll.tsSection navigation — scroll-top/about/contact through smoothScrollTo.

components/dialogs/ — the two modals

FileWhat it does
PreferencesModal.tsx<preferences-modal> — theme slider, reduced-motion/autoplay/grid/stats switches, NPU readout. Genie-opens from nav.
preferences/render.tsxDialog template — WebGL canvas paints the affordance; real inputs receive clicks (double-layered for fallback).
preferences/sync.ts, webgl.ts, types.tsDOM/widget sync, widget mount/teardown, pref.* node shape.
LangDialog.tsx<lang-dialog> — 16-locale grid with WebGL waving flags; selection rewrites the URL and reloads translations.
lang-dialog/events.tsOption clicks, dismissal, the GPU glass-follower highlight.
lang-dialog/locale.tsURL → new-locale mapping — known routes rebuild via localized slug; dynamic routes keep path minus prefix.
lang-dialog/render.tsx, sync.ts, webgl.tsTemplate, open-state sync, per-option FlagWebGL mounts.

components/home/ — landing sections

FileWhat it does
AboutSection.tsx<about-section> — bio block with Gravatar portrait + <draw-text> copy.
ContactSection.tsx<contact-section> — contact footer over the dark band.
HomeMosaic.tsx<home-mosaic> — the masonry project grid: WASM-packed cards, hover previews, skeleton layer.
AwardsMentions.tsx<awards-mentions> — footer awards carousel + legal links.
about/glitch*.tsThe VHS/glitch portrait — ambient corruption always on, ramps to full VHS on hover (channel ghosts, scanlines, slice tears, tracking).
awards/Awards data (SWR fetch), carousel wiring (progress arc), JSX template.
mosaic/Layout engine (sync + WASM), hover interactions, JSX, and the burn pipeline — the paper-combustion title effect where card titles ignite and re-ink themselves (front geometry, particle sim, paper raster, loop).

components/media/ — the media pipeline

FileWhat it does
MediaFigure.tsx<media-figure> — the core media card: thumb → high-res crossfade or muted-autoplay video, skeleton shimmer, expand modal.
figure/load.tsCDN variant matrix + progressive loading — zero-CLS SVG placeholder, detached-preload swap.
figure/modal.ts, mount.ts, render.tsx, video.tsExpand-modal open + deep-link, mount lifecycle, JSX, video plumbing.
DrawText.tsx<draw-text> — character-staggered reveal; per-char delay via WASM so lines land in the target duration.
draw-text/Tokenizer, shared sheet, fit-to-width, trigger wiring.
MediaExpanded.tsx<media-expanded> — fullscreen viewer inside the expand modal.
expanded/Dismissal sequence (genie zoom-out → teardown), mount (full-res pipeline: disk cache → WASM decode → blob swap), four-affordance JSX.

components/carousel/ — carousels

FileWhat it does
CustomCarousel.tsx<custom-carousel> — infinite-loop carousel (clone-ended native scroll), WebGL arrow controls, dot nav, viewport-gated autoplay.
custom-carousel/Arrows/widget wiring, autoplay+progress ring engine, lifecycle, nav (clone teleport), sizing, JSX.
AwardsCarousel.tsx<awards-carousel> — lighter sibling for text/award content (30s autoplay, ≥50% visibility gate).
awards-carousel/Autoplay ticker, events, nav, observer, render, types.

components/portfolio/, components/legal/, components/feedback/

FileWhat it does
portfolio/Related.tsx + related/<portfolio-related> — related-projects strip: fuzzy join of the related node against the home portfoliolist.
legal/Footer.tsx<legal-footer> — shared footer strip: legal links, credits, disclaimer.
feedback/CookieBanner.tsx<cookie-banner> — consent bar persisted to localStorage.
feedback/SiteToast.tsx<site-toast> — the in-page notification fallback surface.
feedback/StatsHud.tsx<stats-hud> — stats-for-nerds overlay fed by statsEngine.

Root files

FileWhat it does
index.tsBarrel — importing it self-registers every <view-*> element transitively.
dev.tsStandalone dev entry — boots the real app shell through the module vite config.
vite.config.jsLibrary build — emits website/dist/website.js.

Commands

yarn dev      # boots the real app shell (shared/src) through this module's vite config
yarn test     # jest suite for website
yarn build    # emits website/dist/website.js

Submodule of luiskr.com-V3. Install deps from the superproject (yarn install at the root), then run yarn dev / yarn test / yarn build in this folder — see package.json scripts.
